source_layer: UTMT GML dump + generated clean raw/wiki data

source.runtime_supply_demand: table_supply_demand + settlement economic_data are dynamic. Static cells use clean GML defaults; UI runtime controls add user-provided decimal modifiers for matching a save/screenshot.
source.merchant_gold_filter: Default merchant rows require scr_npc_gold_init max gold >= 300. Lower ranges and missing init are audited in coverage.excluded_candidates.
source.fact_policy: Forum/player discussion is a demand signal only; formulas, fields, classifications, and prices in this file come from clean raw, UTMT/GML, official translations, or explicit resource mappings.

formula.demand_material_cell: Material_BP_Mod shown as percent; material base BP is not used by the tooltip row
formula.player_sells_to_merchant: round(base_price * stolen_fine * stack * (category_BP + material_BP + item_BP) * (1 + category_BP_mod + material_BP_mod + item_BP_mod + BP_Fluctuation) * BP_Mod * (1 + Trade_Favorability) * durability_mod * props_mod)
formula.player_buys_from_merchant: round(base_price * stack * (1 + category_SP_mod + material_SP_mod + item_SP_mod + SP_Fluctuation) * SP_Mod * (1 - Trade_Favorability) * durability_mod * props_mod)

supply_demand_table.usage: GML settlement economic table weights; UI runtime controls use decimal modifiers.

description.en: Nature takes back what's hers: nearby meadows and forests are once again alive with fresh growth.
description.zh: 自然夺去了属于她的生机，附近的草地和树林又一次生出了新叶和嫩芽。
